content.test_md_blob:
# Hover a performance point to inspect the custom tooltip

> Prove hovering a chart point shows the custom tooltip near the active point, updates the displayed date, portfolio value, benchmark value, and return, and leaves summary cards unchanged.

## Step 1

Open {{portfolio_overview_url}} in a browser and wait for the Portfolio Overview workspace to finish loading with the Portfolio Performance card visible.

## Step 2

On the Portfolio Overview page, store the current values shown in the dashboard summary cards as baseline_summary_cards and confirm no performance-chart tooltip is currently visible.

## Step 3

Store the pre-hover chart detail state as baseline_hover_state, including the absence of tooltip date, portfolio value, benchmark value, and return.

## Step 4

Hover a visible data point on the Portfolio Performance chart and inspect the hover state near the active point.

## Step 5

Assert a custom tooltip appears near the active point, the active point shows an outer ring and inner dot, the tooltip displays a date, portfolio value, benchmark value, and return that differ from baseline_hover_state, and the dashboard summary cards still match baseline_summary_cards.

## Step 6

Confirm the hover treatment is custom chart UI rather than a default browser or graph-library tooltip.

## Step 7 — assert @verifies ac-14, ac-24, ac-32, ac-33, ac-34, ac-35, ac-36, ac-37, ac-38, ac-40

Confirm propagation check: custom tooltip when hovering a chart point (exists) — the stated promise: Hovering a chart point shows the custom tooltip.
